name: Son Doc cracker
summary: Bánh phồng Sơn Đốc is glutinous rice pounded with coconut milk and sugar, grilled until the cracker puffs to three or four times its size. Later pieces also take milk, egg, durian, or jackfruit.
origin: Sơn Đốc, xã Hưng Nhượng, Giồng Trôm. The portal’s 20 May 2024 article is the source.
history: More than 100 years on that article, first as a Tết sweet. Quyết định số 4069/QĐ-BVHTTDL of 30 October 2018 lists it with bánh tráng Mỹ Lồng.
howToEat: Grill it over charcoal, with tea. The portal mentions milk, egg, durian, and jackfruit versions in recent years. The yards run all year, and the pounding runs late near Tết.
where: Sơn Đốc, xã Hưng Nhượng, Giồng Trôm, with the work in the hamlets and ấp Hưng Bình. Clause 88 keeps the name Hưng Nhượng. A kilometer from town: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Son Doc cracker — puffed rice from Ben Tre
seoDescription: Bánh phồng Sơn Đốc is glutinous rice with coconut milk and sugar, grilled until the cracker puffs.
